name: uiuc_airfoil_search
description: Search the UIUC Airfoil Coordinates Database (University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, Applied Aerodynamics Group) by name or family — e.g. "naca", "eppler", "selig", "goettingen", "wortmann", "drela ag", "clark y", or part of an airfoil's own code (e.g. "2412", "s1223"). Returns the total match count first, then up to `limit` airfoil names/descriptions/families. Use uiuc_airfoil_geometry for coordinates and computed thickness/camber.

query.description: Name, partial name, or family keyword (e.g. "naca", "eppler", "2412", "goe")

family.description: Exact family filter: NACA, Eppler, Selig, Wortmann, Goettingen, Drela AG, Clark Y, Wright Brothers, Liebeck, or Other

name: uiuc_airfoil_geometry
description: Fetch one airfoil's coordinate file live from the UIUC Airfoil Coordinates Database (University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, Applied Aerodynamics Group) and compute its geometry: point count, max thickness and max camber (each as a fraction of chord, with the chordwise location they occur at), derived from the raw (x,y) coordinates. Pass the airfoil's name as listed by uiuc_airfoil_search (e.g. "naca2412", "e58", "s1223").

include_coordinates.description: Include the full raw (x,y) point list in the response (default false — only the summary geometry)
